patterns.note: The site employs a dynamic, varied grid system for content sections, alternating between full-width elements and multi-column layouts with diverse aspect ratios to showcase projects.
A strong typographic contrast is established by pairing large, elegant serif fonts for prominent headings with clean, legible sans-serif fonts for body text and functional labels.
A sophisticated, muted base palette of greys, off-whites, and browns is strategically punctuated by occasional full-bleed, vibrant accent colors (e.g., magenta) and rich project imagery.
Content blocks and sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a smooth and engaging content flow.
The footer features an exceptionally large, all-caps serif rendition of the brand logo, serving as a powerful and memorable visual anchor at the bottom of every page.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed image or video carousel (swiper, video-hero) that auto-advances, with subtle pagination indicators at the bottom right.
Content sections are revealed using a staggered fade-up animation as they scroll into view, creating a dynamic but smooth content flow.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility to key site sections throughout the user's scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (approx. 3-4x body) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a sophisticated hierarchy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed, auto-playing visual carousel as its hero, combined with a dynamic grid layout that fluidly integrates diverse project visuals and occasional vibrant accent sections, creates a highly visual and engaging experience. The oversized serif logo in the footer serves as a powerful and memorable brand statement.
